condition: HDFStore.select with where plus start/stop and chunksize or iterator=True applies the start/stop window to the list of matching rows instead of the table rows, so it returns the wrong rows.
workaround: Don't combine start/stop with chunksize/iterator. Either call select without chunking, or get the coordinates with select_as_coordinates(key, where, start=, stop=) and read them in chunks by passing those coordinates as the where argument.
